WITH units AS (
    SELECT s.sentreg, t.ordertypedist, s.instownpct AS ownership
    FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s
    JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON s.transref = t.transreg
    WHERE s.instownpct IS NOT NULL
      AND t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
), baselined AS (
    SELECT units.*,
           AVG(ownership) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS mix_baseline,
           AVG(ownership) OVER () AS overall_average
    FROM units
), kept AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM baselined
    WHERE ownership > overall_average
)
SELECT AVG(ownership) AS average_kept_ownership,
       AVG(ownership / mix_baseline) AS average_ownership_to_mix_baseline_ratio,
       AVG(ownership - overall_average) AS average_excess_overall_average
FROM kept;

assumptions.assumption: Missing institutional ownership values are excluded from the mix and overall averages and cannot qualify as kept units; snapshots without a matched transaction or with a missing order type mix are excluded as requested.
